title: SWIM: Step-Wise Integrated Measure for Session-supervised List Evaluation in Generative Re-ranking
abstract: arXiv:2608.25104v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Modern industrial recommender systems have increasingly adopted the Generator-Evaluator (G-E) framework for the re-ranking stage. Within this paradigm, the generator produces candidate item lists from a pool filtered by upstream retrieval and ranking modules, while the evaluator scores these lists and selects the highest-scoring one for final exposure per request. However, on sequential platforms (e.g., short-video apps), users consume items continuously, ignoring artificial list boundaries. Conventional evaluators score lists by aggregating point-wise values, implicitly assuming exposure independence. This fails to capture critical session-level dynamics, such as contextual dependencies, user continuation, and diminishing marginal utility from repetitive content.   To bridge this gap, we propose SWIM (Step-Wise Integrated Measure), a list-level evaluator that models user behaviors as a finite-horizon prefix session-level survival proces

translated_title: SWIM：面向生成式重排序中会话监督列表评估的逐步集成度量
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.25104v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：现代工业推荐系统越来越多地采用生成器-评估器（G-E）框架用于重排序阶段。在该范式中，生成器从上游检索和排序模块过滤后的候选中生成候选项目列表，而评估器则对这些列表进行评分，并为每个请求选择得分最高的列表进行最终展示。然而，在顺序平台（如短视频应用）上，用户会连续消费内容，忽略人工定义的列表边界。传统评估器通过聚合逐点值来对列表进行评分，隐含地假设曝光独立性。这无法捕捉关键的会话级动态，例如上下文依赖、用户连续性以及重复内容带来的边际效用递减。为弥合这一差距，我们提出SWIM（逐步集成度量），一种列表级评估器，将用户行为建模为有限时域的会话级生存过程。
tldr: 该论文提出SWIM，一种基于会话级生存过程的列表级评估器，以捕捉用户连续消费中的上下文依赖和边际效用递减，改进生成式重排序中的列表评估。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SWIM, a list-level evaluator based on session-level survival processes, to capture contextual dependencies and diminishing marginal utility in continuous user consumption, improving list evaluation in generative re-ranking.
